verdict.rationale: Lium is a GPU rental marketplace that agents consume. It is not an agent or host application that plugs in MCP servers to use their tools, so the MCP-client axis does not apply. Its documented MCP server at `/mcp` is the server role, which belongs to a different story and does not make this client axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
